name: TStructureTruncationConstraint
claim: t-structure axiom D^{<=0} ∩ D^{>=1} = {0} is mandatory for admissibility

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of t-structure truncation axiom constraint

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic computation for t-structure axioms

positive_1_standard_tstruct.d_leq_0: complexes F with H^i(F) = 0 for i > 0
positive_1_standard_tstruct.d_geq_1: complexes F with H^i(F) = 0 for i <= 0
positive_1_standard_tstruct.intersection_property: Any F in both must have H^i(F) = 0 for all i => F = 0

positive_2_perverse_tstruct.d_leq_0: perverse sheaves P with codim(supp H^0 P) >= 1 and codim(supp H^-1 P) >= 2
positive_2_perverse_tstruct.d_geq_0: perverse sheaves P with codim(supp H^0 P) >= 1 and codim(supp H^-1 P) >= 2
positive_2_perverse_tstruct.truncation_axiom: Intersection is zero by perversity conditions

positive_3_tilted_tstruct.construction: Given stability condition sigma, define D^{<=0} = {E : phase > 1/2} union {0}

negative_2_both_cohomology.description: Object with H^-1(E) nonzero and H^1(E) nonzero
negative_2_both_cohomology.claim: Such E cannot satisfy truncation axiom
negative_2_both_cohomology.reason: E has nonzero cohomology above 0 => not in D^{<=0}; and below 0 => not in D^{>=1}

negative_3_degenerate_tstruct.claim: If D^{<=0} = D, then D^{>=1} must also equal D, so intersection is D (not {0})
negative_3_degenerate_tstruct.reason: Fails minimality and coheartness conditions; not a t-structure

boundary_1_heart_objects.description: Objects in the heart A of t-structure
boundary_1_heart_objects.property: E in A iff H^i(E) = 0 for i != 0 and H^0(E) = E

boundary_2_concentration_limit.claim: As H^i(E) spreads across more degrees, E moves further from heart A
boundary_2_concentration_limit.scaling: Measure 'spread' = #{i : H^i(E) != 0}; larger spread => farther from A

boundary_3_minimal_shifted.description: Rank-1 or simple object in D^{<=0} \ D^{>=0}
boundary_3_minimal_shifted.example: S[-1] where S is simple in heart
boundary_3_minimal_shifted.property: In D^{<=0} (H^i=0 for i>0) but NOT in D^{>=0}
boundary_3_minimal_shifted.intersection_with_d_leq_0: Boundary of D^{<=0}; not in D^{>=1}

cvc5_proof_status: UNSAT for non-trivial object in intersection; admissible iff truncation axiom holds
